_help: One-time localization inputs consumed by scripts/i18n-translate.mjs. The translate step REFUSES to run until status is 'locked'. Bumping glossaryVersion (or changing register) invalidates every key and forces a full re-translation on the next run, so terminology stays consistent across every release.
_register_help: 'je' = informal. Dutch consumer software is overwhelmingly informal; 'u' would make a warm app about someone's pets read like a utility bill. 'u' = formal.
